fusions.name: Fingers in the Pot
fusions.desc: Flicks a stolen morsel that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds, lowering its dodge. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Lifted Purse
fusions.desc: Plucks at every wound: deals 16 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds, uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Napkin Trick
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Swing and Snatch
fusions.desc: As you cover ground, you restore 8 stamina. Once every 8 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.
